facts.statement: The Israelites camped near Mount Sinai.
God promised to make obedient Israel His special treasure.
The Israelites promised Moses they would ignore God’s commands.
God told the people to wash their clothes before He came.
God told all the people to climb Mount Sinai to meet Him.
God descended on Sinai with fire, smoke, and thunder.
Mount Sinai stayed quiet and still when God came down.
God spoke the Ten Commandments from the mountain.
The people celebrated and asked God to speak even louder.
The frightened people asked Moses to speak to God for them.
Moses stayed in the camp while God spoke from Mount Sinai.
Moses stayed on the mountain for forty days to receive God’s law.
Moses was on the mountain for 400 days.
God said the people would hear Him speaking with Moses.
